title: 노른자가 또!

cuts.scene: Kitchen. wife, frustrated, looking at a broken egg yolk in a bowl. hands in exasperation.
Kitchen. husband, leaning against the counter, observing wife with a dry expression. A beat later.
Kitchen. wife, eyes wide, picking up the clay toy product from the counter next to her.
Kitchen. wife, surprised, uses the clay toy product to separate the egg white and yolk successfully.
Kitchen. husband, still leaning, a slight smirk playing on his lips. His line is a beat late.
White background. guide appears, holding a product card with '계란 흰자 분리기' and then a stamp with '글쎄'.
Kitchen. wife, already moving towards a cabinet, a hopeful glint in her eyes, about to open it.
Kitchen. husband, still in the same spot, flatly delivers the line, looking at wife who is about to open the drawer.

situation: 아침 계란 요리 중 노른자 터짐
